ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Advait Energy Transitions Limited, through its subsidiary Advait Battery Ecosystems Private Limited, has secured a significant Master Supply Agreement with BloombergNEF Tier 1 manufacturer Hithium for up to 1 GWh of lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery cells over the next year. This agreement is crucial for establishing a dependable supply chain for Advait's new 2.5 GWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) assembly facility, materially strengthening its capabilities and strategic position in India's growing domestic energy storage manufacturing sector. A minor note is the document's stated date of September 19, 2026, which is in the future.
